unchanged_science_gates.active_mask_rule: S_ref computed once from complete primary cohort; active if local natural scale > sqrt(machine_eps)*S_ref, near-null otherwise, no posthoc exclusions

controls.Y_off_old_Repair22_baseline_reproduction: When the new Stage E Y module is disabled and the historical Y piece restored for an isolated adapter control, reproduce old Repair22 Z20 and p0 to 1e-11 relative L2; diagnostic comparator only.

outcomes.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: Any frozen parent/source match, adapter reproduction, new boundary recomputation or execution integrity gate fails.
